gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with a histologically confirmed or suspected high-grade glioma (HGG) by MRI.

candidate_evidence.quote: On Day 7, participants will begin combination antiretroviral therapy (ART) consisting of Abacavir, Lamivudine, and dose escalation/de-escalation of Ritonavir (RTV), to determine the recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D) of Ritonavir.
Synergistic Treatment With Antiretrovirals and Laser Interstitial Thermal thErapy (STARLITE) for Unresectable High-Grade Gliomas: A Phase 1 Study

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in patients with newly diagnosed high-grade glioma(s) that cannot be removed surgically.

role_evidence.quote: Participants will take one 600mg tablet of Abacavir orally once daily, as part of combination antiretroviral therapy (ART).
Participants will take one 300mg tablet of Lamivudine orally once daily, as part of combination antiretroviral therapy (ART)
combination antiretroviral therapy (ART) consisting of Abacavir, Lamivudine, and dose escalation/de-escalation of Ritonavir (RTV), to determine the recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D) of Ritonavir.

agents.drug_class_hint: antiretroviral (HIV protease inhibitor; also CYP3A inhibitor/booster)

flag.reason: Ritonavir is often used as a pharmacokinetic booster; here it is dose-escalated (100-600 mg) as the study drug, so coded as a candidate rather than delivery-enabling, but the record states no purpose.

role_evidence.quote: Participants will take Temozolomide (TMZ) via capsule orally, during and after focal radiotherapy, as part of standard of care adjuvant therapy.

source_quote.quote: Patients with human leukocyte antigen (HLA) HLA-B*5701 hypersensitivity (Section 10.1.6.7).

flag.reason: HLA-B*5701 is a pharmacogenomic safety exclusion, not a tumour biomarker; listed for transparency, adjudicator may drop it.

coder_notes: Population is high-grade glioma with no explicit mention of glioblastoma anywhere in the record, so excluded at S5 (high_grade_glioma_unspecified). Candidate fields filled anyway: abacavir/lamivudine/ritonavir antiretroviral regimen is the investigational component; no antitumour mechanism stated beyond 'Synergistic Treatment'. Collaborator Medtronic (likely LITT device); text does not state drug supply.
